full_judgment: 16. Now let me examine the legal position in this regard. Section 96 of the State Acquisition and Tenancy Act clearly provides that a pre-emption application must be filed within 4 months form the date of registration of the deed or within 4 months from the date of knowledge of the transfer in question where notice under section 89 is not served. The burden of proof that the application has been filed within 4 months of the date knowledge of the transfer heavily lies upon the applicant.
